question: In The Delian Tomb adventure, what happens if a character tries to open one of the sarcophagi or take items from the treasure room?
expected_answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack the party.

bm25_free_haiku.answer: Three skeletons emerge from random sarcophagi and attack the party. Exception: characters who swore the Delian Oath can take the Edict Blade (+1 longsword, +2 vs goblinoids) without triggering the trap. Sarcophagi contain 3d20 gp in gems; skeletons wear gold circlets worth 30 gp. Source: The_Delian_Tomb.pdf p.7-8.
search_queries: Delian Tomb sarcophagi treasure room trap

quality.notes: Core answer correct (three skeletons attack). Bonus context about the Delian Oath exception, treasure contents, and skeleton loot.
